name: Up Only
hook: Flap through the chart. Bank before the rug.
tagline: A one-tap skill game: a shiba in a wif hat flaps through a live candlestick chart, threading the gaps between green candles from support and red candles from resistance while shitcoins fill the bag on his back and a FUD cloud gathers behind him. Cash out to land on a private jet before the round flips every candle red and pulls the floor.
